status: Exact bounded management/work value normalization proposal. Native width and scalar/list mappings complete; two explicit quantity-tag decisions remain open. No runtime/full HC acceptance.
scope: All 369 unique fact definitions referenced by 25 management/work operations; source type/quantity tag/list shape normalization only. Own earlier registry reviewed as self-audit, not independent acceptance.

decisionBasis.approved: Exact widths, CopperValue, Scalar|List with fixed scope/shape and post-filter ordinals. CommandScalar only for three specified physical request uses; no management/work fact uses it.

commonRules: Scalar has exactly Value and no Values when available. List has only immutable ordered Values, including legitimate empty authorized projection.

Unavailable states omit both Value and Values and protected cause data. No nested lists, null elements, arbitrary object values, dynamic wasFiltered/hidden-count flag or availability-driven cardinality change.
Every list element shares the declared scalar kind and applicable width/code family/unit. Repeated scalar subjects remain separate typed instance context, not nested arrays.

No widening native Int32 into V1 width64; no reinterpretation of native monetary Int64 as Quantity. Quantity components retain normalized native Int64 numerator/denominator; exactly one concrete unit or dimension on available values.
Source record amounts, not current recalculation or planned cost, supply retained facts. Receipt joins, field-specific current authority, private redaction and native absence remain unchanged.
No CommandScalar use in this registry. No mining value rank/damaged shortlist/private DC/RNG seed/hidden count or historical research-modifier reconstruction is introduced.

branchBindings.rule: After existing authority, only actual Success/CriticalSuccess/Failure/CriticalFailure with ResolvedAt and native Degree/selection applies. Working/Paused/AwaitingCheck/TerminalNoCheck has no actual roll. FirstDie/Natural are positive actual d20 results. For MW-F195, SecondDie==0/Normal means NotApplicable with no Value; Advantage/Disadvantage has the actual Int32 second die. Do not publish native DC, seed, word count, value ordering or damaged shortlist.

Only FormulaWorkKind.Research Success/Failure has an actual check. Copy Success is not a roll. AwaitingCheck/Working/Paused/Cancelled produces no dice. MW-F261 Second==0 means NotApplicable; present second die remains Int32. MW-F263 modifier is Int32 only from the actual immediate carrier, never later reconstructed from character state.

Only the actual completed check retained in AwaitingChoice/Complete applies; Working/Paused/AwaitingCheck has no roll. MW-F337 Second==0 means NotApplicable. Natural and First remain actual native Int32 values. MW-F332 is actual immediate captured Int32 modifier. Do not infer or add a TakeTen producer; current native start/check path remains unchanged.

Completed actual settlement plus RetainedCatalyst>=0 gives native Int32 selected catalyst index. Native -1 means no retained catalyst selection; NotApplicable/no Value for this index field. This selected native component index is not a public list ordinal and must not be renumbered after filtering. Independent component identity/custody authority is unchanged.

Actual completed Mishap settlement has Int32 native mishap code 1..6. Native 0 for no mishap is NotApplicable/no Value for this outcome-code field; it is not a die result of zero. Existing Quality remains the separate actual quality fact.

These source fields can have a real available zero under their original applicability: fixed monetary zeros, strain, actual free capacity after completion, signed modifier zero, completed phase count zero, material-set index zero, no extra vials, XP zero, structural HP zero. Do not convert all numeric zero into absence.

After exact current field predicate and native applicability, empty native sentinel means NotApplicable with no Identity Value. Present identity must retain its exact causal/subject join. Never emit empty string as an entity or introduce a new predecessor link.

Nullable HasValue is required for the corresponding available Time value; null means event not applicable/yet occurred per original field applicability, never time zero. Existing hidden authority denial is evaluated first.
